OPEN INTEREST (OI) 101 - Using $NVDA

If you trade options, you should understand Open Interest (OI).

Volume = contracts traded during the day.

OI = contracts that remain open.

Look at $NVDA Oct. 16:
CALL OI
$250 → 74.4K
$260 → 68.6K
$270 → 19.7K

PUT OI
$220 → 49.1K

The change in OI tells you whether positions are building, unwinding, or staying flat.

That’s why I like tracking the same strikes over multiple days instead of looking at one snapshot. https://t.co/BDh4tSpaKc
